t: Here on Whitehall, outside the Ministry of Defence Main Building, stands the statue of Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery, Viscount Montgomery of Alamein. He served in the First World War, the Irish War of Independence and the Second World War. The statue is by Oscar Nemon, a Croatian-born sculptor who settled in England and is best known for more than a dozen statues of Winston Churchill. Montgomery stands alongside two other soldiers in bronze, Viscount Slim and Viscount Alanbrooke.
